26412047.effect: Destroy one faceup attack-position monster with global maximum current ATK across both players. No targeting.
26412047.choice: Only ties generate resolution HintMsg.Destroy; choose opponent from actual offered ties or lowest-value own unavoidable card if board changed.
26412047.limitations: Does not simulate responses, immunity, or destruction replacement.

43422537.effect: Set current-turn normal summon/set cap to 2, not add one to cap; no once-per-turn activation restriction.
43422537.choice: No card choice. Stateless policy requires two distinct currently offered level 1-4 hand developments and two empty main zones, scored before ordinary development.
43422537.limitations: Conservative partial support: excludes opportunities after first normal summon/set, tribute continuations, special summon-count mechanisms and restrictions after the first development.

72302403.effect: Normal Spell remains on field, flips facedown enemy monsters at resolution, prevents opponent attack declarations while its field effect applies, self-destructs after third opponent end phase.
72302403.choice: No card choice. Avoid duplicate active faceup copy; accept reveal or visible battle threat.
72302403.limitations: No forecast of future removal, re-enabling negated copy, piercing, attack effects or future enemy draws.

70342110.effect: On opponent attack declaration, automatically targets attacker; banishes at resolution if it remains related, attackable and attack not cancelled.
70342110.choice: No card choice or pending target queue. Observe current enemy attacker and UnderAttack; preserve defense-position attackers.
70342110.limitations: Own pending Prison target or Mirror Force is a conservation heuristic, not proof of outcome. No broad trap-immunity guard because inherited ImmuneTrapMonster means trap destruction immunity.

validation.nativeInterpretation: All ten duels completed with normal retirement. Logs confirm actual effect activation/resolution and tied Hammer selection; synthetic tests additionally cover mixed-side ties, changed identity, negated responses and pure probes. Fixtures deliberately favor their test condition; win/loss counts are not strength evidence. Both recorded host seats were exercised; opening-turn role was not forced. The first six duels used the effects-only binary; the final four used the same card behavior after the learning-provenance rebuild, as recorded by their hashes.

corrections.name: Chixiao hand-only banish cost
corrections.source: c69248256.lua:54-66; discost selects HAND+GRAVE before distg target

corrections.name: Chengying two resolution prompts
corrections.source: c96633955.lua:68-81; separate field and grave selections, not targeting; replacement 55-63 selects own grave
corrections.before: Single combined preselection was consumed by field prompt, leaving grave choice without intended strategy.
corrections.after: No trigger preselection; OnSelectCard uses actual resolving immutable snapshot and actual offered enemy field/grave candidates, with own replacement isolated.
corrections.regressions: ExpertProbe.ChengyingChecks: 11 assertions including changed live source, later chain, activation-stage exclusion and replacement isolation.

corrections.name: Evenly Matched context ownership
corrections.source: c15693423.lua:32-40; resolving effect asks opponent to banish exact field-count difference
corrections.before: Any enemy chain plus remove hint and matching field counts could be misclassified as Evenly.
corrections.after: Require resolving enemy Evenly activation snapshot.
corrections.regressions: ExpertProbe.EvenlyChecks: 4 assertions including unrelated source, mutation and activation-stage exclusion.

corrections.name: Longyuan duplicate discard preference
corrections.source: c93490856.lua:26-32; matching hand card discarded as cost; expert source loops individual checkId
corrections.before: Per-ID duplicate loop counted all IDs in the entire priority list, treating distinct resources as duplicates.
corrections.after: Count the current ID, preserving genuine duplicate preference and actual held fallback.
corrections.regressions: ExpertProbe.LongyuanChecks: 4 assertions including duplicate MoYe before lone Taia and sole valid cost.

corrections.name: Taia planning respects used Baxia revival
corrections.source: c56495147.lua:63-76; Taia sends matching deck resource; c83755611.lua:31 and 68-83 limits Baxia revival; expert stores Baxia+2 when revival accepted
corrections.before: Used flag was accidentally passed as faceUp option and tested wrong marker, so Taia planned spent revival.
corrections.after: Use explicit face-up check and the already-recorded Baxia+2 marker as separate condition.
corrections.regressions: ExpertProbe.BaxiaChecks: 6 assertions covering unused/used revival target and per-turn reset.
